--- Bulk RNAseq of B16OVA tumors from WT mice treated with bitherapy or tritherapy ---

Pre-processing and differential expression analysis: The RNA-seq count matrix was imported and filtered to retain genes with a mean count >10 across samples. Gene identifiers were extracted and made unique, and the sample metadata were imported. A DESeq2 dataset was then generated using the "group" variable (Bitherapy or Tritherapy) as the design factor, followed by differential expression analysis. The resulting DESeq2 object was saved as an RDS file for downstream analyses.

```{r DESEQ file MV, include=FALSE}
data <- read.table("/Users/bjung/Desktop/Bulk_RNAseq_analysis_revision_TICIMEL/count_table_MV_B16OVA_tri_vs_bi.txt")
matrix_data <- as.matrix(data)
numeric_matrix_data <- apply(matrix_data, 2, as.numeric)
rownames(numeric_matrix_data) <- row_names <- rownames(matrix_data)
keep=rowMeans(numeric_matrix_data)>10
numeric_matrix_data=numeric_matrix_data[keep,]
dataframe <- as.data.frame(numeric_matrix_data)
countData <- round(dataframe)
symb <- sapply(strsplit(rownames(countData), "_"), `[`, 2)
symb[is.na(symb) | symb==""] <- rownames(countData)[is.na(symb) | symb==""]
rownames(countData) <- make.unique(symb)

coldata <- read.table("/Users/bjung/Desktop/Bulk_RNAseq_analysis_revision_TICIMEL/coldata_MV_B16OVA_tri_vs_bi.txt", header = T)
dds_MV <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(countData),
  colData = coldata,
  design = ~group,)

dds_MV <- DESeq(dds_MV)

saveRDS(dds_MV,"/Users/bjung/Desktop/Bulk_RNAseq_analysis_revision_TICIMEL/dds_MV.RDS")

```

GSEA and pathway enrichment network analysis: Differentially expressed genes were ranked according to their log2 fold-change values, and GOBP enrichment analysis was performed using GSEA. Significantly enriched pathways were subsequently visualized using aPEAR to identify clusters of functionally related pathways. The resulting enrichment network was exported as an SVG file and used for Fig. 3c.

```{r plot aPEAR MV,fig.width=25, fig.height=10}
rm(list = ls())
set.seed(1234)
dds_MV <- readRDS("/Users/bjung/Desktop/Bulk_RNAseq_analysis_revision_TICIMEL/dds_MV.RDS")
count_table_MV <- counts(dds_MV)
res_df_tri_bi <- as.data.frame(results(dds_MV, contrast = c("group", "Tritherapy", "Bitherapy")))
res_df_tri_bi$gene <- rownames(res_df_tri_bi)
res_df_tri_bi <- res_df_tri_bi[, c("gene", setdiff(colnames(res_df_tri_bi), "gene"))]


gene_list <- res_df_tri_bi$log2FoldChange  
names(gene_list) <- rownames(res_df_tri_bi)
gene_list_entrez <- bitr(names(gene_list), fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db)
gene_list <- gene_list[gene_list_entrez$SYMBOL]
names(gene_list) <- gene_list_entrez$ENTREZID
gene_list <- sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE)
enrich <- clusterProfiler::gseGO(geneList = gene_list,
                                 OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
                                 ont = "BP",
                                 pvalueCutoff = 0.01)
results_df_tri_bi <- as.data.frame(enrich@result)
rm(enrich, gene_list_entrez, gene_list )

aPEAR.theme$innerCutoff <- 0.05
aPEAR.theme$outerCutoff <- 0.9

aPEAR.theme$fontSize <- 6
aPEAR.theme$repelLabels <- T
```

GO term simplification and visualization: Pathways belonging to the selected cluster "positive regulation of leukocyte activation" were extracted. Redundant GO terms were then reduced based on their similarity using rrvgo. The remaining GO terms were visualized according to their normalized enrichment score (NES), pathway size, and adjusted p-value. The resulting plot was exported as an SVG file and is used for Fig 3.d.

```{r plot rvvgo MV,fig.width=20, fig.height=7}
#Extract pathway from the cluster : "positive regulation of leukocyte activation"
immuno_cluster_pathways_tri_bi <- path_clusters_tri_bi$clusters %>%
  dplyr::filter(Cluster == "positive regulation of leukocyte activation") %>%
  dplyr::pull(Pathway)

#Filter results_df_tri_bi with pathway from the cluster
immuno_cluster_filtered_results_tri_bi <- results_df_tri_bi %>%
  dplyr::filter(Description %in% immuno_cluster_pathways_tri_bi)


simMatrix_tri_bi <- calculateSimMatrix(immuno_cluster_filtered_results_tri_bi$ID,
                                orgdb="org.Mm.eg.db",
                                ont="BP",
                                method="Rel")

#rvvgo
scores_tri_bi <- setNames(-log10(immuno_cluster_filtered_results_tri_bi$p.adjust), immuno_cluster_filtered_results_tri_bi$ID)

reducedTerms_tri_bi <- reduceSimMatrix(simMatrix_tri_bi,
                                scores_tri_bi,
                                threshold=0.9,
                                orgdb="org.Mm.eg.db")

non_redundant_reducedTerms_tri_bi <- reducedTerms_tri_bi %>%
  filter(term == parentTerm)

final_immuno_cluster_filtered_results_tri_bi <- immuno_cluster_filtered_results_tri_bi %>%
  filter(ID %in% non_redundant_reducedTerms_tri_bi$go)

final_immuno_cluster_filtered_results_tri_bi <- 
  final_immuno_cluster_filtered_results_tri_bi %>%
  unite(goDescription, ID, Description, sep = " - ", na.rm = TRUE, remove = FALSE)

#Create plot
plot_go <-
  final_immuno_cluster_filtered_results_tri_bi %>%
  arrange(NES) %>%
  mutate(
    goDescription = str_wrap(goDescription, width = 60),
    goDescription = factor(goDescription, levels = goDescription)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = NES, y = goDescription, size = setSize, fill = -log10(p.adjust))) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#D1C4E9", high = "#675FAA",
    limits = c(2, max(-log10(final_immuno_cluster_filtered_results_tri_bi$p.adjust))),
    oob = scales::squish
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(3, 10), trans = "sqrt") +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +          # <- étiquettes à droite
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "NES (Normalized Enrichment Score)",
    y = NULL,
    size = "Pathway size",
    fill = "-log10(p.adjust)",
    title = "Simplified GO Term from 'positive reg of leucocyte activation' cluster"
  ) +
theme(
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
  axis.text  = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", size = 20),
  axis.text.y.right = element_text(hjust = 0),
  axis.text.y.left  = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.y.left = element_blank(),
  plot.margin = margin(10, 30, 10, 10),
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24, hjust = 0.01),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
  legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm")
)
#Plot
print(plot_go)
#SVG save
ggsave("REVIGO_tri_bi.svg", plot = plot_go, device = "svg", width = 15, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

Heatmap of chosen genes : The expression levels of selected genes (Prf1, Gzmb, Klrk1, Ifng, and Tbx21) were extracted from the DESEQ2 object. Expression values were standardized as z-scores, and samples were grouped according to their treatment group (Bitherapy or Tritherapy). The resulting heatmap was exported as an SVG file and is used for Extended data Fig 5.d.

```{r Heatmap gene chosen MV, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}

dds_MV <- readRDS("/Users/bjung/Desktop/Bulk_RNAseq_analysis_revision_TICIMEL/dds_MV.RDS")
counts_norm <- counts(dds_MV, normalized = TRUE)
meta <- as.data.frame(colData(dds_MV))

genes_interest <- c("Prf1", "Gzmb","Klrk1","Ifng","Tbx21")

scores_t    <- counts_subset
scores_t_z  <- t(scale(t(scores_t)))
scores_t_z[is.na(scores_t_z)] <- 0   # variance nulle -> 0


stopifnot(all(colnames(scores_t_z) %in% rownames(meta)))
treatments <- meta[colnames(scores_t_z), "group", drop = TRUE]

  Treatment = treatments,
  col = list(Treatment = c(
    "Bitherapy" = "#06AC8B",
    "Tritherapy" = "#675FAA"
  ))
)

  breaks = seq(-3, 3, length.out = 11),  # -4, -3.2, ..., 4
  colors = rdBu
)


hm_gene_chosen <- Heatmap(
  scores_t_z,
  name = "z",
  top_annotation    = ha,
  show_row_names    = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  column_split      = treatments,
  col = col_fun,
)

draw(hm_gene_chosen)


# SVG save

svglite::svglite("/Users/bjung/Desktop/Bulk_RNAseq_analysis_revision_TICIMEL/hm_gene_chosen_MV.svg",

)

)
dev.off()
```

--- Bulk RNAseq of B16OVA tumors from hTNF x hTNFR2 mice treated with Bitherapy or Tri certo or Tri inflix or Tri minflix IgG1) ---

Pre-processing and differential expression analysis: The RNA-seq count matrix was imported and filtered to retain genes with a mean count >10 across samples. Gene identifiers were extracted and made unique, and the sample metadata were imported. A DESeq2 dataset was then generated using the "treatment" variable (including Bitherapy or Tri certo or Tri inflix or Tri minflix IgG1) as the design factor, followed by differential expression analysis. The resulting DESeq2 object was saved as an RDS file for downstream analyses.

```{r DESEQ file TMP, include=FALSE}

data <- read.table("/Users/bjung/Desktop/Bulk_RNAseq_analysis_revision_TICIMEL/count_table_TMP_B16OVA_bi_vs_infliximabs_vs_certo.txt")
matrix_data <- as.matrix(data)
numeric_matrix_data <- apply(matrix_data, 2, as.numeric)
rownames(numeric_matrix_data) <- row_names <- rownames(matrix_data)
keep=rowMeans(numeric_matrix_data)>10
numeric_matrix_data=numeric_matrix_data[keep,]
dataframe <- as.data.frame(numeric_matrix_data)
countData <- round(dataframe)
symb <- sapply(strsplit(rownames(countData), "_"), `[`, 2)
symb[is.na(symb) | symb==""] <- rownames(countData)[is.na(symb) | symb==""]
rownames(countData) <- make.unique(symb)
coldata <- read.table("/Users/bjung/Desktop/Bulk_RNAseq_analysis_revision_TICIMEL/coldata_TMP_B16OVA_bi_vs_infliximabs_vs_certo.txt", header = T)


dds_TMP <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(countData),
  colData = coldata,
  design = ~treatment,)

dds_TMP <- DESeq(dds_TMP)

saveRDS(dds_TMP,"/Users/bjung/Desktop/Bulk_RNAseq_analysis_revision_TICIMEL/dds_TMP.RDS")

```
